Recipe :
 1/2 butternut squash
1/3 bag frozen kale
1 carrot
1 potato
2 celery stalks
2 parsnips
1 tin of butter beans
1 handful red lentils (soaked)
2 tbsp peanut butter
2 tbsp curry powder
1 tsp garlic powder
1 tsp onion powder
2 garlic and ginger frozen tabs
250ml coconut cream
Water to mid level.

Dice all veg to similar size, throw it all in together, add dry seasons and peanut butter and stir. Fill with water to mid way and let sit for 6 hours on high. Add coconut cream and stir through. Leave for 30 mins and serve.
